name: Tridhya Tech Ltd.
summary: Tridhya Tech Ltd. is a full-service software development company that provides a range of IT services and resources. Its primary offerings include e-commerce development, mobile app development, web development, custom software products, API development, digital marketing services, product support, maintenance, and IT staff augmentation. The company also engages in turnkey consultancy services and integrates emerging technologies such as Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), and the Internet of Things (IoT) into its solutions. Tridhya Tech serves a diverse range of industries, including e-commerce, real estate, transport and logistics, insurance, BFSI, healthcare, retail, and education. It operates with a global reach, catering to international markets in the Middle East, Europe, and Asia-Pacific, with delivery centers located in India. The company's industry focus is primarily on IT Services & Consulting and Software Infrastructure.
